theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_cbm_smooth_trace
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (G : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1)) (δ : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 v → ContDiff ℝ 1 G → (∀ y, ‖G y‖ ≤ 1) → 0 ≤ δ → δ ≤ 1 / 4 → |∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, v x * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ G x)| ≤ (2 * (m + 1) + 1) * (∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, ‖fderiv ℝ v x‖) + 4 * (m + 1) * ∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, |v x|
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
